summary: Firefox improved video decoding and encoding across Android, Linux, and Windows, including Android MediaCodec and Linux Vulkan Video, which can use graphics hardware to process video. The changes refine support checks for formats such as H.264 and HEVC, improve handling of frame size, color depth, bitrate, and low-latency playback, and make recovery from decoder or process failures more reliable. This should help Firefox choose compatible playback paths and avoid glitches or failures on more devices.
